tabs.resizeSplit: Drag to resize the split view (double-click to reset)
tabs.splitOn: Split view: session on the left, other screens on the right
tabs.splitNeedsSession: Open a session to use split view
tabs.rightEmpty: Pick a screen from the sidebar or the tab bar to show it here, beside the session.

settings.title: Windows & tabs
settings.desc: Surfaces (PR Inbox, Calendar, Slack threads, Todos, Notes, files) always open as tabs of the main window. Pop a tab out from its right-click menu, or ⌘-click a file link.
settings.dockOnUnplug: Dock windows back as tabs when a screen is unplugged
settings.dockOnUnplugHint: When the second screen goes away, its PR Inbox / Calendar / Slack… windows come back into the main window as tabs.
settings.permFloat: Pop up approval windows while Devdy is in the background
settings.permFloatHint: With Devdy in front, permission requests are answered in the main window. Off: only a notification while you're in another app.
settings.splitCompactSidebarHint: While the main window shows two tabs side by side, the sidebar shrinks to its icons to give both panes more room.
